title: ONLYOFFICE Docs: attackers can read or change files
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The severity score is critical (9.8).

category.label: Documents and collaboration
category.why: It holds shared documents and internal pages.
category.doThis: Patch it, or ask your provider whether they have.

summary: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 11, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2021-3199 as actively exploited
